title: A seat outside the wseat allow-list still fills its impression
specNotes: OpenRTB 2.6 §3.2.1 BidRequest.wseat: "Array of names for allowed buyer seats." A responding seatbid.seat outside this list is a request/response consistency violation the auditor should surface; Core has no id for it, so `expected.crosscheck.seat.not_allowed` is a placeholder for the finding a future rule should emit — see tests/corpus/known-gaps/mut-multiplicity.json DEF-192.
Browser measured on 2026-09-08 in run ortbtools-audit-9fSncA; only the exact observed product deviations are admitted. Normative finding and successful-analysis assertions are retained.
